free_tier.stated: Homepage headline: 'Your free and unlimited file storage'. No numeric total quota published anywhere on the site.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: The FAQ names storage time expiration as a removal reason but publishes no duration; the terms say premium files are kept for twice as long as free files. No numeric retention period is stated.

egress.terms: Free downloads capped ~5 GB/day at roughly 55-60 KB/s; Turbo 40 GB/day, 600 GB/month. No per-GB charge.

tooling: Same Turbobit-family stack (Uploader app, FTP). No documented public API.
chaining: Sister host of Turbobit with the same 'unlimited volume' claim; chain = N email accounts, serving bounded by per-IP/day caps.
limits_note: Per-file cap not published on the pages read (unverified). Retention ends on 'storage time expiration'. Free speed ~55-60 KB/s, one download per IP with queueing.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: Free speed ~55-60 KB/s, one download per IP with queueing. anonymous-dump

reliability_note: Blog/inventory claim only. 'unlimited' is a headline, with no docs page stating it and no per-file number anywhere. Treat the quota as unverified.
